title: 고2 레벨테스트 B형
description: 중급~고급: 모의고사형 어휘((A)/(B) 고르기 포함), 관계부사·가정법 도치(Had I)·Only after 도치·가정법 현재·enough 어순, 기억 심리 글(주제·빈칸)·도구 쓰는 동물 글(순서·지칭) 읽기, 배열·영작

passages.title: The Serial Position Effect
passages.text:
Why do we remember the beginning and end of a list better than the middle?
Psychologists call this the serial position effect.
Items at the beginning are rehearsed more often, so they move into long-term memory.
Items at the end are still in short-term memory when we try to recall them.
The middle items, however, get neither advantage.
This explains why speakers often put their most important point ____________.

passages.title: Animals That Use Tools
passages.text:
Many animals use tools to get food.
(A) For example, they push sticks into termite mounds and pull them out covered with insects.
(B) Chimpanzees are a famous case.
(C) Some birds, such as crows, have also been seen bending wire into hooks to reach food.

items.explanation: recall = 기억해 내다, 회상하다 (취소하다 cancel, 반복하다 repeat, 거절하다 refuse)
advantage = 이점, 유리한 점 (단점 disadvantage)

items.stimulus: The two plans are very similar; the only ____ is the cost.
items.explanation: 두 계획은 매우 비슷하다 → 유일한 차이(difference)는 비용이다.

items.prompt: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
items.stimulus: The evidence was (A) [sufficient / insufficient], so the judge could not make a decision. Later, new evidence (B) [confirmed / denied] his guilt, and he was sent to prison.
items.explanation: (A) 판결을 내릴 수 없었다 → 증거가 불충분한(insufficient). (B) 감옥에 갔다 → 새 증거가 유죄를 확인했다(confirmed).

items.stimulus: likely to change suddenly and without warning
items.explanation: 예고 없이 갑자기 바뀌기 쉬운 = unpredictable(예측할 수 없는) (reliable 믿을 만한, permanent 영구적인, obvious 명백한)

items.prompt: 문맥상 단어의 쓰임이 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Her generous donation helped many children.
The scientist's hypothesis was finally proved by experiments.
The road was so narrow that two trucks could easily pass each other.
Regular practice leads to steady improvement.
items.explanation: 길이 너무 좁은데(narrow) 트럭 두 대가 쉽게 지나갈 수 있다는 것은 어색하다. → so wide that ~ 또는 could not pass

items.stimulus: We need to ____ new words several times before they move into long-term memory.
items.explanation: 장기 기억으로 넘어가려면 새 단어를 여러 번 반복해야(repeat) 한다.

items.prompt: 문장 속 came up with와 뜻이 가장 가까운 것을 고르세요.
items.stimulus: Scientists came up with a new theory.
items.explanation: come up with = (생각·계획을) 내놓다, 제안하다 ≒ propose

items.stimulus: This is the reason ____ I was late.
items.explanation: 선행사 the reason + 완전한 문장 → 관계부사 why

items.stimulus: Had I known the answer, I ____ you.
items.explanation: Had I known = If I had known(가정법 과거완료의 if 생략·도치) → would have p.p.

items.stimulus: The books on the shelf ____ to my brother.
items.explanation: 주어는 The books(복수), on the shelf는 수식어 → belong. belong은 상태동사라 수동태로 쓰지 않는다.

items.stimulus: Only after the meeting ____ how serious the problem was.
items.explanation: Only + 부사구가 문장 앞에 오면 도치 → 조동사 did + 주어 I + 동사원형 realize

choices: She insisted that he be present at the meeting.
The data were analyzed, and it show a clear pattern.
Despite of the rain, we went out.
I have known him since five years.
items.explanation: insist that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형(당위) → he be present. ② it shows ③ Despite the rain (despite에는 of를 쓰지 않음) ④ for five years

items.stimulus: Frankly ____, I don't like the plan.
items.explanation: 관용적 분사구문 Frankly speaking = 솔직히 말해서 (Generally speaking 일반적으로 말해서)

choices: The man I spoke to was the manager.
There is no point in arguing with him.
The more you practice, the better you get.
She is enough old to drive.
items.explanation: enough는 형용사·부사 뒤에 온다 → She is old enough to drive.

choices: 목록의 처음과 끝이 더 잘 기억되는 까닭
items.explanation: 첫 문장의 질문(왜 처음과 끝을 더 잘 기억하는가)에 대해 serial position effect로 설명하는 글

items.prompt: 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: in the middle of the speech
at the beginning or the end of the speech
items.explanation: 처음과 끝은 잘 기억되고 가운데는 어느 이점도 얻지 못한다 → 가장 중요한 내용은 연설의 처음이나 끝에 둔다.

items.prompt: 목록의 처음 항목이 잘 기억되는 까닭은 무엇인가요?
choices: 더 자주 되뇌어 장기 기억으로 넘어가기 때문에
items.explanation: 'Items at the beginning are rehearsed more often, so they move into long-term memory.' 최근에 들어서 기억되는 것은 끝 항목이다.

items.prompt: 첫 문장 다음에 이어질 (A)~(C)의 순서로 가장 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 도구를 쓰는 동물 → (B) 대표적인 예 침팬지 → (A) For example, they(침팬지)가 막대기로 흰개미를 잡는다 → (C) also, 까마귀 같은 새도 도구를 쓴다
(B) 다음에 오는 (A)의 they는 앞 문장의 Chimpanzees를 가리킨다. 흰개미 둔덕에 막대기를 넣는 주체이다.

items.prompt: 까마귀에 대한 설명으로 글과 일치하는 것을 고르세요.
choices: 철사를 구부려 갈고리를 만들어 먹이를 꺼낸다.
items.explanation: 'crows, have also been seen bending wire into hooks to reach food.'

items.prompt: 우리말 뜻에 맞는 영어 단어를 쓰세요.
items.explanation: 이점 = advantage (benefit도 정답)

items.prompt: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰세요.
items.stimulus: ______ by the loud noise, the baby started crying. (frighten)
accept: Frightened by the loud noise, the baby started crying
items.explanation: 아기가 소음에 '놀란' 것 → 수동의 분사구문 (Being) Frightened

items.prompt: 주어진 말을 바르게 배열하여 문장을 쓰세요.  (연습하면 할수록, 너는 더 잘하게 된다.)
items.stimulus: ( you / the more / practice / , the better you get )
items.answer: The more you practice, the better you get.
accept: The more you practice the better you get
items.explanation: the 비교급 + 주어 + 동사, the 비교급 + 주어 + 동사 = ~할수록 더 …하다

items.prompt: 우리말에 맞게 영어 문장을 쓰세요.  <조건> If를 쓰지 말고 Had로 시작할 것
items.stimulus: 내가 그 사실을 알았더라면, 너에게 말했을 텐데.
items.answer: Had I known the fact, I would have told you.
accept: Had I known the fact I would have told you
Had I known the truth, I would have told you
Had I known the truth I would have told you
Had I known it, I would have told you
Had I known it I would have told you
Had I known that, I would have told you
Had I known that I would have told you
items.explanation: If I had known ~에서 If를 생략하면 도치 → Had I known ~, I would have told you.
